reviews.text: Had the best experience with Sen Moon Bounce. The slides were so fun and the dunk tank was the perfect touch to our event. 10/10 would highly recommend!!!
This is the 2nd year in a row that we’ve used Sen Moon Bounce! They’re very quick to setup moon bounce and have great service. Will definitely continue to use them for family events and parties.
You can tell they really know their stuff, professional and smooth from start to finish.
